hero_subtitle: Explore how Hartlepool Borough Council manages public money. Reform UK won 13 of 36 seats (36%) at the 7 May 2026 election — a significant breakthrough but not the largest party. Full transparency data coming soon.
publisher_bio: This website was created by Tom Pickup, Reform UK county councillor for Padiham and Burnley West and Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care at Lancashire County Council. He is also parish councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw. Tom builds transparency tools that make public spending data easier to check.
publisher_titles: County Councillor for Padiham and Burnley West
Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care, Lancashire County Council
Parish Councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw
publisher_quote: It's your money. The more people understand where it goes, the better.

political_control.tenure_note: Reform UK minority administration since the May 2026 Annual Council. Cllr Graham Harrison (Reform) Leader, Cllr Mike Young (Reform) Deputy. NOC: Reform 15/36 (largest), Labour 14, Independent 7; 19 needed. Reform inherited the budget set on 3 March 2026 under the outgoing Labour administration of then-Leader Pamela Hargreaves: core council tax frozen (passed unanimously, against the S151 officer's formal 4.99% advice), 1.98% ASC precept only, balanced via a Labour-moved £1.58m of extra savings on top of £4.5m planned. DSG high-needs deficit £4.9m heading to about £22m by March 2028.
political_control.source: hartlepool.gov.uk councillors index + Full Council 3 March 2026 budget papers + council news (Hargreaves quote, 5 Mar 2026; Reform leadership, May 2026); verified 2 July 2026.

doge_context.political_control: Reform UK breakthrough — 13/36 seats (36%) at the 7 May 2026 election. Not largest party.

spend_triangulation.note: Transparency gross = £650.3M across every class in the published corpus. Procurement-paid (discretionary third-party payments) = £646.8M. Non-procurement rows: Care-Act redacted direct payments to individuals (£3.5M) — all excluded from third-party-supplier forensic analyses. Net revenue budget figures (where published) are smaller again because they net capital, grants received, and reserves movements — transparency totals include all of these.

procurement_paid.note: Discretionary third-party supplier payments — the real procurement footprint.

direct_payment_individual.note: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions — foster carers, SGO recipients, ASC service-user direct-payment holders. Lawfully unnamed.
